fields.label: Brand Name
fields.description: Replaces Frappe and ERPNext as the product name: the browser tab, the sign-in page, emails and the About dialog.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.description: Shown under the brand name in the sidebar and on the Launcher.

fields.label: Apply Brand to Site Settings
fields.description: Writes the brand into System Settings, Website Settings and Navbar Settings, and turns off the vendor update and change-log pop-ups. The values it replaces are kept and restored when OneSpace is uninstalled.

fields.label: Replace Frappe and ERPNext in Labels
fields.description: Every label, menu, title and message on the desk that names Frappe or ERPNext names the brand instead (ERPNext Settings becomes OneSpace Settings, Frappe HR becomes OneSpace HR). Links to the vendors' websites are hidden, or sent to your own Support Website when one is set. Routes and DocType names are unchanged.

fields.label: Hide Frappe and ERPNext Help Links
fields.description: Hides the Documentation, Forum and School entries that point at frappe.io and erpnext.com.

fields.label: Logos
fields.description: Leave empty to use the OneSpace artwork that ships with the app.

fields.label: App Icon
fields.description: Square. Used for the sidebar, the app tiles and the splash screen.

fields.label: App Icon Style
fields.options:
Colour Tiles
Brand Tiles
OneSpace Icon
Original Logos
fields.description: Every installed app - Frappe HR, Helpdesk, Healthcare, CRM and your own - gets an icon drawn in the OneSpace style. Colour Tiles match the Launcher; Brand Tiles are charcoal with the orange of the OneSpace icon. OneSpace Icon gives every app the brand icon; Original Logos keeps each vendor's own.

fields.label: Apps
fields.description: Optional. Rename an app, or choose its glyph and colour. Anything left empty is chosen automatically. Use Add Installed Apps to list them.

fields.label: Sidebar Style
fields.description: Carbon keeps the module sidebar dark in light mode too, as the deep charcoal rail of the OneSpace design.

fields.label: Open the Desk on the OneSpace Launcher
fields.description: The Launcher is the apps view: every app this user may open, quick actions, recent documents and this week's activity. Frappe's own Apps screen stays at /desk/desktop.

fields.label: Show System Health to System Managers
Quick Action DocTypes
fields.default:
Quotation
Sales Invoice
Customer
Stock Entry
fields.description: One DocType per line. Each user only sees the ones they may create.

fields.label: Recent Document DocTypes
fields.default:
Sales Order
Sales Invoice
Purchase Order
Quotation
Purchase Invoice
Delivery Note
Purchase Receipt
Quality Inspection
fields.description: One DocType per line. Recent documents and weekly activity are read through each user's own permissions.

fields.label: Use OneSpace Sign-in
fields.description: Serves the OneSpace sign-in page at /login. Sign-in, sign-up, forgot password, email link, social logins, LDAP and two-factor are Frappe's own and work as before.

fields.label: Headline
fields.default: Run your whole business in one space.

fields.label: Sub-headline
fields.default: Sales, stock, accounts and people on one engine - with every number where you expect it.

fields.label: Highlights
fields.default:
Role-based access on every record
Audit trail on every change
Real-time ledgers and stock
fields.description: One per line, up to six.

fields.label: Footnote
fields.description: Leave empty for a copyright line with the brand name.

fields.label: Panel Image
fields.description: Optional. Drawn behind the brand panel under a dark scrim.

fields.label: Support Website
fields.description: Added to the help menu as Support.

fields.label: About Text
fields.default: OneSpace is your business platform for sales, purchasing, stock, accounting, manufacturing and people.
fields.description: Shown in the About dialog in place of Frappe's.
